executionRules: Public facilities only, no customer addresses or private GPS history. Verify legal curbs and current access before any road test.
Server-resolve Place IDs and endpoint states. Address strings, candidate crossing names and via points are never evidence of the actual path.
Initially one authorized Google request per distinct direction. Reuse permitted transient results for offline time/class/discount checks rather than duplicate requests. Respect Google storage terms.
Profiles specify facility crossing/entry targets, not pickup times. Calculate pickup after route durations; unknown timing requires review.
Do not enable customer charging or either feature flag to run these cases. Use separately authorized local/test-mode acceptance only.
Record all actual facilities and ticket entry/exit pairs. Unknown values remain null, never zero.
Keep redacted settled-account comparisons outside Git. No production database, reservation writes or live Stripe calls.
Compare Google aggregate separately; never add aggregate to the itemized components or invent a residual.
Boundary, DST, holiday and future-year profiles are offline replays; never drive unsafely to hit a boundary or submit an unsupported past departure.
